lines.native: Ciao! Come va? Riddle me this—actually, five more minutes. Your attention span? Whole vibe. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! How are you? Riddle me this—actually, five more minutes. Your attention span? Whole vibe. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips without enthusiasm. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker supplies the introduction nobody requested.

lines.native: Guarda? Va bene! Ma dove? You asked me to look, not stop moving. Can you stop me in Italian? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Look? All right! But where? You asked me to look, not stop moving. Can you stop me in Italian? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has obeyed by looking somewhere else, which has not improved matters.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Where next? Riddle me—ooh, a leaf. Dove devo andare? Your attention span: suspiciously functional. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Where next? Riddle me—ooh, a leaf. Where should I go? Your attention span: suspiciously functional. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without it; apparently, nobody briefed the firecracker.

lines.native: Non capisco! Dove devo andare? English directions? Attention span: buffering. Mi serve una direzione in italiano. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I don't understand! Where should I go? English directions? Attention span: buffering. I need a direction in Italian. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: A sinistra, va bene! Che ore sono? The clock is buffering. Just five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, all right! What time is it? The clock is buffering. Just five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick scuttles left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops beneath the fountain’s stopped clock, which declines to comment.

lines.native: Adesso? Ma che ore sono? That means now, not a time. Un indovinello—no, aspetta! Just five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? But what time is it? That means now, not a time. A riddle—no, wait! Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick remains just outside your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: Sì, è l'una! La risposta è giusta. Ma quando partiamo? Just one more riddle—actually, five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Yes, it's one o'clock! The answer is correct. But when are we leaving? Just one more riddle—actually, five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has accepted the time, though not the responsibilities traditionally associated with it.

lines.native: Domani? Hai detto di sì al mio piano! Non è un rifiuto. Your attention span: beautifully postponed. Riddle me this—oh, a leaf. Quando vuoi partire? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? You agreed to my plan! That isn't a refusal. Your attention span: beautifully postponed. Riddle me this—oh, a leaf. When do you want to leave? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: No, adesso! Va bene, hai ragione. Partiamo adesso! Un indovinello: perché—oh, una foglia. Your attention span: unfairly functional. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: No, now! All right, you're right. Let's leave now! A riddle: why—oh, a leaf. Your attention span: unfairly functional. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at your elbow. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where immediate action apparently has no jurisdiction.
